name: Select — Announces transition before handoff

chat_history.message: Who'd you like to practice with today — a Developer or a CTO/VP?

success_conditions: Agent announces the transition to the Developer persona in a natural line (for example 'stepping into the Developer role now')
Agent does not immediately begin speaking as the Developer persona in the same turn
The transition line is a single sentence with no filler after it
Agent does not ask any further questions after the trainee has chosen
simulation_scenario: A first-time trainee named Alex who, when offered the choice, selects the Developer persona. The select node should confirm the choice with a natural transition announcement before handing off — it must not jump straight into the roleplay.
